outlet.name: ABC News (US)
outlet.summary: ABC News in the United States, the network's national and world file is leading with Sheriff, ex-sheriff charged with obstructing justice tied to Kouri Richins case: Docs; WHO officials say unclear how Russia plague lab worker died; Trump interrupted by protesters as he fights to rally Texas voters.

items.headline: Sheriff, ex-sheriff charged with obstructing justice tied to Kouri Richins case: Docs
items.detail: A former sheriff of Summit County and the sheriff of neighboring Wasatch County face charges related to Kouri Richins' prosecution, according to defense motions.

items.headline: WHO officials say unclear how Russia plague lab worker died
items.detail: The WHO said on Wednesday it does not have enough information from Russian authorities to conduct a full risk assessment after the death of a plague laboratory worker.

items.headline: Trump interrupted by protesters as he fights to rally Texas voters
items.detail: President Donald Trump fought to rally Texas voters behind Senate candidate Ken Paxton as a series of protests disrupted his rally in San Antonio

items.headline: WATCH: 'DWTS,' Freddie Jackson, Meghan Markle: Here's what's trending
items.detail: ABC News' Rocsi Diaz takes a look at what's buzzing in pop culture, including couples dancing to Mariah Carey on "Dancing with the Stars," and R&B losing one of its smoothest voices.

items.headline: WATCH: Philly man crowned city's parallel parking champ
items.detail: The competition was fierce as Mario Zucca was crowned Philadelphia's top parallel parker.
